ROSES IN THE THORNS

An Autobiography
Author: Mrs. Didi Esther Walson-Jack, OON, mni

Before the apex titles, there is a personal story Mrs. Walson-Jack chose to tell in her own words. Roses in the Thorns is a true-life story of resilience and the triumph of faith over adversity. Published in 2017 by Kraft Books Ltd, Ibadan, it encourages women who shy away from sharing their problems to speak openly, and it comforts others who face the same thorns.

“A true-life story of resilience and the triumph of faith over adversity.”

I Planted

A Memoir of Purposeful Service
Didi Esther Walson-Jack

A memoir of purposeful service, published in 2026 by Safari Books: the story of a woman who chose to build when it would have been easier to wait, and who believed that seeds sown in difficult soil can produce an extraordinary harvest.

Beyond the Mandate

Leadership, Legacy & Labour
Didi Esther Walson-Jack

A memoir on leadership, legacy and the labour of public service. It reflects on reform in Nigeria’s public service, with lessons from her career on integrity, resilience and institutional impact, and serves as a guide for purposeful public service.
